settings.question: How is this different from glutathione pills?
settings.answer:
Most glutathione tablets are broken down in the digestive system, meaning very little reaches your bloodstream.

Glutathione IQ uses smart delivery pure glutathione, which protects the molecule and improves absorption significantly.

This results in higher plasma glutathione levels — which is what drives visible skin changes.
